results.title: Centrality of the congruence kernel for elementary subgroups of Chevalley groups of rank >1 over noetherian rings
results.abstract: We prove the centrality of the congruence kernel for the elementary subgroup of a Chevalley group G of rank >1 over an arbitrary noetherian ring R (under some minor restrictions on R if G is of type C_n or G_2).
